summary: Special permission required before undertaking repair, painting, or window replacement on notified heritage facade structures.

steps.title: Prepare heritage impact assessment
steps.description: Architectural conservationist prepares structural report preserving character-defining elements.

steps.title: Submit proposal to Heritage Committee
steps.description: Submit proposed materials, paint swatches matching original exposed brick/concrete aesthetic.

steps.title: Heritage Conservation Committee review
steps.description: Panel of architects and historians assesses whether facade integrity is preserved.

steps.title: Issuance of Facade Clearance NOC
steps.description: Obtain conditional approval letter with strict preservation directives.
